name: io.github.holetron-lab/rcll
title: RCLL
description: RCLL — team memory for agent fleets. Built on Hindsight (github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight, MIT). Self-hosted shared memory over MCP: rooms, hierarchical L0–L3 depth, pgvector.

environmentVariables.name: RCLL_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the RCLL backend (self-hosted). Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:5100. The pre-rebrand name HINDSIGHT_URL is still read as a fallback.

environmentVariables.name: RCLL_BANK
environmentVariables.description: Default memory bank ID for retain/recall. The pre-rebrand variable MEMPALACE_BANK is still read as a fallback; see mcp-server/README.md.
